title: Aurora rumoured at RAF Machrihanish

tellings.quote: there were rumors it was based out of the UK for a while at a remote Scottish base called RAF Machrihanish.

plain: Aurora, a rumoured secret aircraft, was said at one point to be based at RAF Machrihanish, a remote military airbase in Scotland. A researcher named Nick Cook tells Michels this as a rumour, without naming its source. If it were true, a secret aircraft would have been flying out of Britain sometime between the late 1980s and the late 1990s.
